voices.note: the tanna of the תניא at 6a.2
anonymous voice of the 6a.6 recipes and the Rav Bibi bar Abaye narrative

props.gloss_en: Abba Binyamin: had the eye been given leave to see, no creature could stand before the demons
Abaye: they are more numerous than we are, and stand over us like the ridge of earth around a furrow
Rav Huna: every one of us has a thousand at his left and ten thousand at his right
Rava: the crowding at the kalla is from them; fatigued knees are from them; the Sages' clothes wearing out is from their rubbing; bruised feet are from them
one who wishes to know of them: sift fine ashes around his bed, and in the morning he sees something like chicken tracks

one who wishes to see them: take the afterbirth of a black firstborn cat born of a black firstborn cat, burn it, grind it, put it in his eye and he sees them; seal it in an iron tube with an iron seal lest they steal it, and seal his mouth so he is not harmed
narrative: Rav Bibi bar Abaye did so, saw them and was harmed; the Sages prayed for mercy on him and he was healed
